subject: Next steps: NovaHealth vendor enrollment & self-billing setup
messages:
From: Lucia Mendez <lucia.mendez@novahealth.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-12-09T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding — NovaHealth AP packet and PO requirements

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we had a quick follow-up from AP. NovaHealth is starting a Q1 vendor roll-in and your team is on the shortlist. Before we can enable you as a self-billing supplier in our portal we need: 

- Completed AP onboarding packet (company details, tax/VAT registration, bank confirmation)
- Confirmation on PO handling: we require a unique PO number on every invoice and PO number must be present in the top-level <cbc:ID> element for our UBL ingestion.
- Clarify whether Redwood supports self-billing (Nova issues the invoice on our behalf) or we will accept vendor-submitted invoices.
- Sample invoice (PDF) and a UBL (XML) example with the PO reference inserted.

Can you send the packet and a quick note on the self-billing option by EOD Thursday?

Appreciate it —
Lucia
Procurement Manager
NovaHealth Systems
[Attachment: novahealth_vendor_requirements_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 95 KB)]

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Lucia Mendez <lucia.mendez@novahealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-09T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — NovaHealth AP packet and PO requirements

Hi Lucia —

Thanks for the note and for the clear checklist. Quick answers up front:
- We can support both vendor-submitted invoices and NovaHealth self-billing. For Nova-issued invoices (self-billing) we will accept the PDF/UBL you generate; for vendor-submitted invoices we will push UBL with po-ref in <cbc:ID>.
- We will provide a sample UBL with the PO in the top-level ID element and a Redwood-generated sample PDF.
- Bank confirmation: I will request an account confirmation letter from Finance and attach.

I'll attach the completed AP packet and a UBL sample by tomorrow. Karthik, Laura — looping you in for any regional VAT notes (EU reverse-charge) and to prepare the bank confirmation.

Next steps:
1) We attach packet and bank confirmation to this thread.
2) If NovaHealth needs a self-billing agreement signed, please send the DocuSign link and we'll get legal to review (turnaround ~3 business days).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: novahealth_ap_packet_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 220 KB)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Lucia Mendez <lucia.mendez@novahealth.com>, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-10T07:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — NovaHealth AP packet and PO requirements

Hi Lucia / Mina —

Quick VAT note from our side (EU): for several contracts NovaHealth may apply reverse-charge on software services. If NovaHealth is issuing self-billed invoices, please confirm whether you will populate the <cac:TaxTotal>/<cac:TaxSubtotal>/<cbc:TaxCategory> elements with the standard reverse-charge indicators (VAT rate = 0 and scheme ID = "RC"). That helps our ingestion and tax reporting.

Also, for the UBL sample, please note: NovaHealth's ingestion requires the PO reference in <cbc:ID> at document level and the line-level <cac:OrderReference>/<cbc:ID> for each invoiced line. We'll include both in our sample to make sure both ingestion paths are covered.

Attaching a short example snippet (sample-ubl-snippet.xml) in the packet.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood
[Attachment: sample-ubl-snippet.xml (text/xml, 3 KB)]

From: AP Portal Support <ap-portal-support@novahealth.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Lucia Mendez <lucia.mendez@novahealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-11T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — NovaHealth AP packet and PO requirements

Hi Mina —

You're all set on the portal invite. Please follow the registration link below to create your vendor account and upload the AP packet and sample files: 
https://portal.novahealth.com/vendor-onboard/INVITE-7392

Portal notes: 
- Mandatory fields: Legal name, VAT number, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, W-9 / local tax form for non-EU entities.
- For self-billing: enable "Accept Self-Billed Invoices" on the Account > Preferences page. Once enabled, we will send a signed Self-Billing Agreement PDF back to the vendor's portal Documents tab.
- File uploads: UBL (.xml) and PDF invoice both required for processing.
- PO format: PO numbers must be prefixed with NH- (e.g., NH-2026-01542). The ingestion engine will reject PO IDs without the NH- prefix.

We also need a scanned bank confirmation that matches the IBAN you enter. You can upload that via the Documents page or reply to this thread and we will attach it to your portal record.

Regards,
AP Portal Support
NovaHealth Systems
